enlarge.empty: Drop a picture, then press Enlarge.
enlarge.model.help: Which registered model enlarges this picture.
enlarge.scale.help: How much larger the picture becomes.
enlarge.tile.help: How much of the picture the GPU handles at once. Automatic picks from the free memory.
enlarge.face.help: On tries to keep faces clearer. This build stores the choice and does not apply it yet.
enlarge.denoise.help: How much grain to remove, from none to strong. This build stores the choice and does not apply it yet.
enlarge.format.help: The kind of file Save writes. AVIF is the usual choice.
enlarge.quality.help: How much detail to keep in the saved file, from 1 to 100.
enlarge.gpu.help: Which graphics card does the work. Automatic uses the one the suite already chose.
enlarge.error.missing: That file is not on this computer.
